description:
Cast a copy of Wheel of Fortune from exile by paying {2}{R}, unpreparing Naktamun Lorespinner.
Spellweaver Helix's last ability triggers, allowing you to cast a copy of the Extra Turn Sorcery without paying its mana cost, gaining an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the copy of Wheel of Fortune, causing each player to discard their hand; at least one player fails to draw more than one card due to the Draw Hate effect.
At the beginning of your next extra turn, Nakatmun Lorespinner triggers, becoming prepared.
Repeat.
